criteria.description: Worker domain model exposes Telemetry and Pressure fields plus pressure level, capacity class, action, and per-signal detail types.
Database migrations add telemetry and pressure JSONB columns to workers with non-null empty-object defaults.
PgWorkerRepository reads and writes telemetry and pressure JSON fields.
Worker advertisement upsert updates an existing row only when the incoming last_advertisement_at is at least as new as the stored row.
